rationale: After reaching a maximum favorable excursion of 1.19% (~$41.55) just above the $41.36 take-profit target, price has reversed sharply higher across five consecutive 1-minute green candles on expanding volume (77,002 shares on the most recent bar). Price ($41.96) has reclaimed the 5-minute 9-EMA ($41.89) while VIXY has cooled from +17.17% to +14.46%, erasing nearly all unrealized gains and invalidating the original breakdown momentum. Closing at market preserves the remaining profit rather than risking a stop-out at $42.39.
